'''Pujili''' is a region in [[Seanchan]] continent. [[Gamel Loune]]'s bodyservent [[Mantual]] is from Pujili. The people there have a culture somewhat similar to those of the [[Kaensada Hills]]{{ref/book|11|34}}.
